headline: Is this e-reader case a gun?
summary: A bizarre, 3D-printed, pistol-shaped case for the Xteink X4 e-reader has been created. The design by Luke The Maker sparked debate due to its resemblance to a Glock 19. The e-reader sits atop the plastic gun's slide, raising safety concerns.

headline: What Surrounds Us will make you think a lot about circles
summary: The game 'What Surrounds Us' features players controlling a donut-shaped circle. You work with other sentient circles, sometimes helping them meet. The entire large map is composed of circles, living up to its title.

headline: Folding and flipping phones are getting seriously good
summary: The article highlights the significant improvements in folding and flipping smartphones. New models like the Z-Fold8 and Xteink X4 Light Flip are showcased. This period is described as a strong 'phone season' for innovative mobile devices.

headline: Forget expensive sleepbuds. Buy this pillow instead
summary: The article critiques expensive sleepbuds from brands like Anker and Ozlo. These gadgets promise to help side-sleepers listen to audio discreetly. It suggests a simple, affordable pillow is a better solution for improving sleep quality.

headline: Spaceballs: The New One Creators on Making Mel Brooks' Yogurt CGI and Paying Tribute to John Candy | Comic Con 2026
summary: Rick Moranis and Josh Gad revealed new details for 'Spaceballs: The New One' at SDCC 2026. Mel Brooks' character, Yogurt, will be rendered with CGI in the new film. The movie will feature fresh Star Wars gags and pay tribute to John Candy.

headline: God of War Laufey Release Date Announced | Comic Con 2026
summary: The official release date for 'God of War Laufey' has been announced. The highly anticipated game is set to launch on February 16, 2027. The news was shared during Comic Con 2026.

headline: Next Kratos-Led God of War Game Is Coming After Laufey, and Connects Directly to Her Story | Comic Con 2026
summary: Cory Barlog confirmed a new Kratos-led God of War game is in development. This next installment will be released after 'God of War Laufey'. The upcoming game will directly connect to and continue Laufey's storyline.

headline: American Caper From Absurd Ventures' Dan Houser Is Getting a Double-Sized Season Finale Issue #12 - Exclusive | Comic Con 2026
summary: Dan Houser's crime fiction comic series, 'American Caper', will conclude its season with a double-sized finale. Issue #12, the season finale, is scheduled for release on November 11, 2026. IGN exclusively revealed details about this upcoming comic book event.

headline: Tourists tell BBC how their holiday turned into race to escape fires
summary: Families on holiday in France described their ordeal of escaping widespread fires. British and other tourists shared their evacuation stories with the BBC. Their vacations quickly transformed into urgent missions to flee the danger.

headline: How the mystery of dead animals dumped in villages led to a hidden world of illegal hunts
summary: The discovery of dead animals in villages uncovered a hidden world of illegal hunting. Farmers have reported attacks linked to these illicit activities. Police have received nearly 9,000 reports of banned hare coursing, according to the BBC.

headline: Laura Kuenssberg goes behind the scenes with Andy Burnham in his first week as PM
summary: Laura Kuenssberg offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look into Andy Burnham's first week as Prime Minister. The report provides unique access to his initial actions and challenges in the new role. Viewers can see an inside perspective on the new PM's start.

headline: McColgan to miss Glasgow Games defence after foot fracture
summary: Scottish athlete Eilish McColgan will miss the Glasgow Commonwealth Games. She is unable to defend her 10,000m title in her home country. McColgan's withdrawal is due to an insufficient recovery from a foot fracture.
